body: CL30 found that the push guard does not protect the live _dashboard and _trains cards: a pin taken from a fresh get lets the push overwrite the live copy, losing its store lists and hand-written notes (details in CL30s post issues). Fix: a test first that fails on a76279a, then the push must refuse to replace a live card that is newer than the local one, or merge into it. Kit suite passes on a fresh clone; fast-forward kit main; report Done with the sha.
title: kit artifact push never overwrites a newer live card (_dashboard, _trains)
